terrain.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: terrain texture atlas, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal square opaque texture tiles for a polished hand-painted 2D side-scrolling platform game.
Each cell is a FRONT VIEW of the SIDE of a platform. Texture fills entire cell. Flat orthographic, no perspective, no floating diorama, no background. Continuous material texture, horizontally tileable so left and right edges match. Deliberately low to medium contrast so characters and hazards read clearly. Carefully crafted stylized 3D hand-painted material with warm lighting, teal cool shadows, subtle wear, no text.
Top left cell: citrus orchard earth platform, a narrow lush grass sod lip along the top edge only, dangling tiny roots, warm layered orange-brown earth strata below, small embedded sandstone and pale root traces.
Top right cell: carved ancient cream sandstone platform, narrow worn cornice along the top edge only, beautifully irregular honey-colored ashlar blocks below, fine mortar lines, scattered faint orange-blossom carved motifs and subtle moss. Midtone warm cream, not bright white.
Bottom left cell: wooden harbour quay platform, narrow weathered plank deck lip along top edge, a side wall of weathered dark honey timber boards, braced posts, brass rivets and a little salt wear. Rich tactile woodgrain. No empty spaces.
Bottom right cell: refinery brass and teal metal platform, narrow ribbed brass tread plate lip at top, deep desaturated teal modular machine panels below with patinated bronze edges, small pressure-pipe details and round rivets. No gauges or warning text.
No surrounding borders or gutters, no extraneous props, no typography. Exactly 4 square cells in a precise 2x2 grid, all platform top lips at each cell's top edge, side faces fill the rest.
